advancement.wildskies.all_bright.desc: Find every bright constellation in the sky.
advancement.wildskies.all_moons.desc: Record all eight moon phases through a telescope.
advancement.wildskies.all_planets.desc: Track all six planets, each on 3 different nights.
advancement.wildskies.all_rare.desc: See every rare sight in the Atlas.
advancement.wildskies.first_deep.desc: See a nebula or a galaxy through a Nebula Filter.
advancement.wildskies.first_hidden.desc: Trace a hidden constellation star by star with a Star Lens.
advancement.wildskies.root.desc: Raise a spyglass to the night sky and look up.
advancement.wildskies.starlight_shower.d: Witness a meteor shower in the Starlight. It goes in your Atlas.
block.wildskies.grand_orrery.tip: 3 x 3, three blocks tall: the six planets circle the sun over a walnut table. Right-click: which planets are up tonight.
block.wildskies.north_star_lodestone.tip: Right-click it to bind yourself to it. At night, hold a spyglass or telescope on the North Star (due north, low) for 3 seconds to come back here, once a night.
block.wildskies.orrery.tip: Right-click: pick a planet (it stops turning). Sneak + right-click: is it up tonight? Right-click with the Star Atlas: tonight's task, worth 3 Star Shards. Gives a redstone signal while it's up at night; a comparator reads tomorrow's weather.
block.wildskies.planet_lamp.tip: Given for tracking its planet. Its globe glows and turns.
block.wildskies.planet_mobile.tip: Place it under a ceiling: the planets hang 3 x 3 and two blocks down. Right-click: which planets are up tonight.
block.wildskies.sky_window.tip: Its sky shows on the side that faces you when you place it.
block.wildskies.storm_jar.tip: Rains within 6 blocks, even on a clear day and under glass. Snows in cold places.
block.wildskies.storm_jar.tip2: Waters farmland, crops grow faster, fish bite sooner and rain fish come out.
block.wildskies.telescope.tip: Crouch at it at night and look up. Shift to stand.
item.wildskies.cinder_charm.tip: Monsters notice you from half as far. Quiet to sculk while sneaking.
item.wildskies.nebula_filter.tip: Use on a Telescope with a Star Lens: nebulae and galaxies.
item.wildskies.old_gold_charm.tip: Drops and experience come to you. Sneak to stop it.
item.wildskies.star_atlas.tip: Everything you find in the night sky.
item.wildskies.star_lens.tip: Use on a Telescope: see the faint stars.
item.wildskies.storm_crystal.tip: Grows on a Cloudbuster that catches lightning. Feed it to one to clear every sky.
item.wildskies.verdigris_charm.tip: Slow falling once a fall gets long.
wildskies.atlas.best: Highest at midnight around night %s of %s.
wildskies.atlas.comet_hint: Comes by a few times a year, for three nights.
wildskies.atlas.deep_hint: Needs a telescope with a Nebula Filter.
wildskies.atlas.hidden_in: Hidden in %s. Needs a Star Lens.
wildskies.atlas.notes.0.a: On a clear night, raise a spyglass and look up. The world goes dark and the sky opens.
wildskies.atlas.notes.0.b: Get all of a constellation in the lens, its middle under the sight, and hold still while the studs round the rim light up.
wildskies.atlas.notes.0.c: Tonight's chart at the front shows what's up.
wildskies.atlas.notes.1.a: Set it down facing the sky you want and use it. Scroll zooms in, Shift stands you up.
wildskies.atlas.notes.1.b: Planets wander. Spot one on three different nights to track it.
wildskies.atlas.notes.1.c: Rain hides the sky. Some stars only show in dry lands, where it never rains.
wildskies.atlas.notes.2.a: A Star Lens on the telescope shows faint stars at the deeper zoom. Trace hidden ones by clicking their stars along the lines.
wildskies.atlas.notes.2.b: A bright moon washes them out.
wildskies.atlas.notes.2.c: A Nebula Filter after the lens shows nebulae and galaxies.
wildskies.atlas.notes.3.a: Every new find leaves Star Shards in your pocket, more for fainter and rarer things.
wildskies.atlas.notes.3.b: Shards make the Star Lens and the Nebula Filter, and crumble into Stardust for lamps, glass and Starstone.
wildskies.atlas.notes.3.c: Fill a whole section of this book for a reward.
wildskies.atlas.notes.4.a: Some pages were torn out. Each comes back when you find what's on its stub.
wildskies.atlas.notes.4.b: A page that's back lists its parts. Make it builds it from your pockets.
wildskies.atlas.notes.4.c: Weather blocks, charms, the lodestone and the Sky Window come from here.
wildskies.atlas.notes.5.a: A Cloudbuster keeps rain off above it and grows Storm Crystals that clear every sky.
wildskies.atlas.notes.5.b: A Storm Jar rains within 6 blocks, even on clear days. In the cold it snows.
wildskies.atlas.notes.5.c: An Orrery signals while its planet is up. A comparator reads tomorrow's weather.
wildskies.atlas.notes.6.a: Right-click an Orrery with this book for tonight's task: 3 Star Shards, once a night.
wildskies.atlas.notes.6.b: An asterism: stars ringed in red on tonight's chart. Trace it with a Star Lens.
wildskies.atlas.notes.6.c: Or a nameless figure on tonight's page: find it and hold your view on it.
wildskies.atlas.notes.7.a: See the moon through a telescope to ink its face in. All eight phases pay shards.
wildskies.atlas.notes.7.b: A planet charm works from your hotbar or a charm slot. Each has its own gift.
wildskies.atlas.notes.7.c: Bind to a North Star Lodestone, then hold on the North Star (due north, low) to go home.
wildskies.atlas.recipes.track: Track %s three nights and it comes back.
wildskies.atlas.shower_hint: Seen in the Starlight's meteor showers.
wildskies.atlas.task_asterism: Orrery task: trace the asterism in the red ring.
wildskies.atlas.task_figure: Orrery task: find this figure in the sky.
wildskies.atlas.tips: Raise a spyglass to the night sky, or sit at a telescope. Hold your view on a constellation to join its stars. Scroll to zoom at a telescope. Trace hidden ones star by star with a click.
wildskies.atlas.title: Star Atlas
wildskies.atlas.up_many: %s up tonight you haven't found. Face their way.
wildskies.atlas.up_none: All up tonight are in your Atlas.
wildskies.atlas.up_one: 1 up tonight you haven't found. Face its way.
wildskies.atlas.window: Visible only a few nights in every %s.
wildskies.cloudbuster.cleared: %s's Cloudbuster has broken the storm. Clear skies for %s minutes.
wildskies.cloudbuster.no_global: This world keeps its storms (allowGlobalClear is off).
wildskies.cloudbuster.off: Off: a redstone signal holds it.
wildskies.cloudbuster.on: No rain or snow for %s blocks round.
wildskies.cloudbuster.recharging: Recharging: %s more day(s) before it takes a crystal.
wildskies.configuration.title: Starstruck
wildskies.constellation.bison.legend: The last of the great herd, grazing on starlight.
wildskies.constellation.cactus.legend: Only stands up where the air is dry and the nights are clear.
wildskies.constellation.coyote.legend: Howls at the moon, and the moon never answers.
wildskies.constellation.eagle.legend: Rides the warm air over the canyon all night long.
wildskies.constellation.feather.legend: Dropped by the Eagle, still drifting down.
wildskies.constellation.fiddle.legend: Plays the tune the whole sky dances to.
wildskies.constellation.horseshoe.legend: Hung points up, so the luck never runs out.
wildskies.constellation.hourglass.legend: Turned over every night by a hand nobody has seen.
wildskies.constellation.kettle.legend: Always on the boil for a cowhand coming in from the cold.
wildskies.constellation.key.legend: Opens a door nobody has found yet.
wildskies.constellation.lantern.legend: Left burning on the porch for somebody still out there.
wildskies.constellation.lasso.legend: A loop thrown wide, still waiting for something to catch.
wildskies.constellation.longhorn.legend: Horns so wide the herd walks around it.
wildskies.constellation.lost_mine.legend: Its entrance only shows to those who already know where to look.
wildskies.constellation.old_bell.legend: Rang the town awake for a hundred years, then went quiet.
wildskies.constellation.prospector.legen: Still digging for the claim he swore was there.
wildskies.constellation.rattlesnake.lege: Coils up over the desert. Hear it before you see it.
wildskies.constellation.saloon_doors.leg: Swinging forever, so nobody ever really leaves.
wildskies.constellation.sleeping_fox.leg: Curled up with its tail over its nose until spring.
wildskies.constellation.stagecoach.legen: Late as always, carrying the mail of the dead.
wildskies.constellation.twin_revolvers.l: Drawn at dusk, holstered at dawn.
wildskies.constellation.two_sisters.lege: Back to back, each keeping watch for the other.
wildskies.constellation.wagon_wheel.lege: Rolls once around the sky every year and never arrives.
wildskies.constellation.widows_veil.lege: Worn to every funeral in town, and never lifted.
wildskies.deep.bluebonnet_veil.legend: Blue haze around seven young stars, like dust over a spring meadow.
wildskies.deep.copper_rose.legend: Petals of warm gas, the colour of a new penny.
wildskies.deep.far_herd.legend: A spiral of a hundred billion suns, small as a coin.
wildskies.deep.ghost_lantern.legend: A hollow ring of light where a star blew itself out.
wildskies.deep.spindle.legend: A whole other sky, seen edge-on, thin as a thread.
wildskies.lodestone.bound: Bound to this North Star Lodestone. Hold your view on the North Star to come back.
wildskies.lodestone.overworld: It only knows the Overworld's sky.
wildskies.orrery.away: %s isn't in tonight's sky: no signal.
wildskies.orrery.below: %s is below the horizon tonight: no signal.
wildskies.orrery.up_later: %s will be up tonight: signal on once it's dark.
wildskies.orrery.weather.3: dry, a Cloudbuster keeps it off
wildskies.planet.cinder.legend: Small, grey and shy. Shows itself only a few nights a month.
wildskies.planet.ember.legend: A red coal of a planet that never quite goes out.
wildskies.planet.indigo.legend: Banded in deep blues, the colour of the hour before dawn.
wildskies.planet.old_gold.legend: A ringed giant, slow and heavy as a sack of coin.
wildskies.planet.pale_rider.legend: White and quick. Never in the same place two nights running.
wildskies.planet.verdigris.legend: Green-blue, like old copper on a church roof. It keeps a little moon.
wildskies.rare.starlight_shower.legend: Witnessed a meteor shower in the Starlight.
wildskies.rare.wanderer.legend: A visitor with a long blue tail. It stays three nights, then it's gone for months.
wildskies.recipes.torn: That page is torn out of your Atlas.
wildskies.reward: Atlas section complete: %s! You received a reward.
wildskies.task.asterism: Orrery task for tonight: a small asterism of %s stars to the %s, about %s degrees up. Trace it star by star with a Star Lens (it's ringed in red on your Star Atlas's Tonight page). Worth %s Star Shards.
wildskies.task.done_tonight: You've done tonight's Orrery task. Come back tomorrow night.
wildskies.task.figure: Orrery task for tonight: your Star Atlas's Tonight page shows a figure with no name. Find that constellation in the sky and hold your view on it. Worth %s Star Shards.
wildskies.task.overworld: The Orrery only knows the Overworld's sky.
wildskies.telescope.filter: The Nebula Filter slides over the lens.
wildskies.telescope.lens: The Star Lens clicks into place.
wildskies.view.clouded: Clouded over. Try again when the rain stops.
wildskies.view.moon: The moon is too bright for the faint stars tonight.
wildskies.view.need_filter: A Nebula Filter would show more here.
wildskies.view.need_lens: Too faint: a Star Lens on a telescope would show it.
wildskies.view.no_task: Take tonight's task at an Orrery first.
wildskies.view.not_part: That star isn't part of anything.
wildskies.view.recall.lodestone_gone: Your North Star Lodestone is gone.
wildskies.view.recall.out_of_view: Hold still on the North Star.
wildskies.view.recall.recall_off: The North Star doesn't call anyone home here.
wildskies.view.recall.recall_used: You've been brought back once tonight already.
wildskies.view.recall.roof_there: Something covers the sky over your lodestone.
